name: Hakudaku Miko ~Miko Inma Sou Joku Gishiki~
original_name: 白濁巫女～巫女淫魔双辱儀式～
source:
Village where a powerful monster is sealed gets on the verge of collapsing. Shrine maiden volunteers to reforge the ritual to keep the barrier, but for that she has to spend two nights with village men. On the other hand, there is a succubus who starts and obscene performance to obstruct the ritual. The tensions rises...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-june-2008-rui-wa-tomo-o-yobu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
封印着强大魔物的村庄已濒临毁灭。为了维持结界，巫女自愿重新举行仪式，但她必须与村里的男人共度两个夜晚。与此同时，一名魅魔开始进行淫乱表演，企图妨碍仪式。局势愈发紧张……
